caption: The video captures a fireworks display unfolding against a night sky filled with drifting smoke. A thick green-tinted haze fills the upper and central frame, scattered with green, blue, white and orange sparks and faint wire-like lines at the left, then gradually dims into gray smoke. As the haze clears, a small orange starburst at the lower right expands into a wide multi-point shell with bright green cores, joined by additional gold-and-green bursts blooming across the top and right. A deep red glow swells from the bottom center while several white-headed red ascenders rise, dragging curving spark trails upward through the frame. A tall vertical column of gold fountain sparks builds on the right and keeps lengthening. Sparse individual sparks and short falling trails drift downward throughout the display. Near the close, a utility pole and wire are visible at the lower left.
relations: Green haze dims as smoke clears, revealing expanding orange starbursts and new gold-green shells across the frame.
A deep red glow swells from the bottom while white-headed red ascenders drag curving trails upward.
A tall gold fountain column lengthens on the right as sparse sparks drift downward throughout.
Faint wire-like lines at the left resolve into a utility pole and wire near the close.
